title: Cosmic Fox Dragon Surreal
description: A vibrant red and orange fox with large bat-like dragon wings sits on a floating grassy island. A large black shadowy creature with white eyes and swirling patterns wraps around the fox while a smaller black wolf-like figure stands below near a fiery red flower and a swirling colorful vortex in the water.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a majestic red fox with large dragon wings and golden mane sitting on a floating grassy platform. A black swirling shadowy monster with sharp teeth and glowing eyes coils behind it. In the background a giant cosmic eye with green iris and bat symbol floats in a starry ring surrounded by smaller eyes. Below, a black wolf stands in reflective water next to a massive fiery red chrysanthemum flower. Swirling colorful vortex in the water, flying seeds or petals in the air, vibrant psychedelic color palette, highly detailed digital painting.
